summary.text: Emily Shetty is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 18 who has served since January 9, 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Shetty succeeded Jeff Waldstreicher in the House of Delegates and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.

Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as the Appropriations Committee, the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee, the Legislative Policy Committee, the Audit and Evaluation Committee and the Management of Public Funds Committee.
